title: Mobile/touch: tapping selects/highlights the whole app, obscuring controls
description:
## Resolution (task 1276)

Applied user-select suppression at the SINGLE highest container — apps/desktop/src/styles.css `body` rule — with explicit opt-in for editable elements. This is the cleanest application point: <body> cascades to the Shell root (#root > div, styles.shell) AND to any React portal/overlay/menu rendered under <body>, so no per-panel scattering is needed. Shell.tsx was NOT touched (avoids conflict with task 1280's right-pane layout work).

### Chrome suppression (body)
user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; -webkit-touch-callout:none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;

### Editable opt-in (overrides body none)
input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"], [contenteditable=""] { user-select:text; -webkit-user-select:text; -webkit-touch-callout:default; }

### Why inputs/editors stay selectable
- Actions/code editor (ActionsPanel.tsx) is a plain <textarea> -> covered.
- Stage inline text-edit overlay (StageArea.tsx) is a plain <textarea> -> covered.
- All dialog/property form fields are <input>/<textarea>/<select> -> covered.
- No JSX sets contentEditable on any div (verified: only isContentEditable reads in keyboard guards); the [contenteditable] selectors are defensive/future-proof.
- Shell.tsx resize-drag logic (saves/restores INLINE document.body.style.userSelect) is unaffected: it manipulates the inline style, independent of this stylesheet rule.

### Verification
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: GREEN (all 7 packages).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run: 50 files / 697 tests PASSED (0 failures; no task-1207 fixture failures even surfaced).
- CSS-only change; cascade reasoning verified against the documented root cause (styles.css had no user-select; piecemeal per-panel userSelect:none left gaps).
